02 / CURATORIAL NOTES

Field notes.

What survives when a racing car becomes a model? Number, colour, wing and silhouette are the starting points for reading each object.

COLLECTION METHOD

Different scales. Different rules.

Place models next to one another and note their individual scales. Start with the overall silhouette, then look for what identifies a specific race entry: the number panel, livery or small changes to the body.

The archive keeps the full-size car and the physical miniature in separate records within each entry. A racing season is not the model’s release date; a manufacturer’s catalogue number is not the number printed on the car.
